An '''uprising''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hargeeva]] occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] after a [[Rebel cell (Hargeeva)|rebel cell]] led by [[Stevan Makintay]] grew too quickly against the Hargeevan [[Noble/Legends|nobility]]. The uprising was quashed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nial Pedrin]].<ref name="Firepower" />
